create_array_autovisualizer: create an ArrayAutovisualizer instance with custom maximum_size, cutoff_size_per_axis, and edge_items settings
build_tokenizer_visualizer: build an ArrayAutovisualizer for a tokenizer using the for_tokenizer class method with a SentencePieceProcessor
visualize_array_with_call: visualize an array by calling ArrayAutovisualizer with a numpy array and path to render it in treescope
render_jax_sharding: render a JAX NamedSharding or Mesh object as a visualizable sharding tree in treescope
configure_array_display: configure ArrayAutovisualizer with prefers_column, prefers_row, around_zero, and pixels_per_cell display options
